accepted_curve_review_diagnostics.scope: Descriptive source calibration fit residuals, not independent accuracy or neural Test errors. Review flags do not alter source selection, masks, or model training.
accepted_curve_review_diagnostics.interpretation: Low residual cannot rule out shared scale error, wrong reference units or drift. Large residual may indicate hysteresis, inconsistent repeated presses, incorrect finger routing or reference faults; inspect traces before attributing a cause.

leave_one_press_out.scope: Leave one complete press out within the same test5 and finger. Fit other presses with the frozen calibration QC; score only held core points inside their AD domain. This is conditional on whole-source channel acceptance and fixed finger routing. Whole-record fixed tare is shared. It measures repeated-press consistency, not subject-disjoint, cross-session or neural-model Test accuracy.
leave_one_press_out.interpretation: Report coverage with error: high-force held presses may exceed the AD range of remaining presses. One-press channels have no independent repetition check. Fit residual and repetition error can both miss shared reference scale or finger-routing errors.

experience: 先核实BSQ的N、CMCU的mN及同步时钟；不要排序时间戳后掩盖逆序或跨时钟异常。
最大AD不一定是受测指，test7的支撑拇指尤其容易抢占；歧义指身份应屏蔽。
BSQ零点应固定在姿态稳定空载段；整段均值、翻转前首秒都可能引入系统偏差。
没有完整按压、AD变化不足、单调性弱和拟合力范围坍缩分别记录；缺指不等于整条硬件损坏。
同一AD下参考力明显不一致时，单调相关也可能通过。源拟合残差P90同时超过10N和拟合力范围50%的指通道已屏蔽；较轻残差复核仅作标记，通过基础规则不等于独立精度合格。
单调拟合不能解决饱和、迟滞、佩戴变化或域外数据。域外点必须计入覆盖限制，不能静默夹端点。
test5按原始最近test5口径使用自身整次曲线；源内拟合符合度不等于独立曲线精度。本方案使用现场BSQ作为自身及其他记录的标定输入，不是BSQ完全未参与过标定的评估。
不按模型Test误差挑源或改剔除阈值；最近源失效不静默回退。

calibration_role: all complete eligible presses; test5 uses its own whole curve, other stages use nearest test5; provided offline calibration input
caveats: Experiment1 measures agreement with calibrated CMCU. Experiments2/3/4 use BSQ truth.
Metrics cover the common in-domain, routed, synchronized, EMG-valid subset; exclusions must be read with dataset and calibration QC.

This is calibration-assisted within-person offline evaluation. Test5 BSQ is available input to calibration of the same and other recordings; it is not an untouched-BSQ or subject-disjoint generalization benchmark.
A scored test5 uses its own complete calibration curve. This is calibration-assisted evaluation, not independent curve validation. For other stages, nearest test5 may be before or after the target.
